Class ShipCorrectionState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.state.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.state.ShipCorrectionState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateInterface
public final class ShipCorrectionState extends GameState implements GameStateInterface
Represents the state where players correct issues with their ships in the Galaxy Truckers game. This state is triggered when a ship has validation issues, such as disconnected components or rule violations. Players must fix these issues by either removing problematic components or choosing which ship piece to keep when disconnected.

    • ShipCorrectionState

      public ShipCorrectionState(ShipBoard myShip, Set<ShipBoard> validShipBoards, Map<ShipBoard, List<Set<Point>>> shipPieces, boolean shouldDiscard)
      Creates a new ShipCorrectionState with the specified parameters. Initializes the state with the player's ship, valid ship boards, disconnected ship pieces, and discard flag. Determines the initial validity and connectivity status of the player's ship.
      Parameters:
      myShip - The ship board of the local player
      validShipBoards - Set of ship boards that have passed validation
      shipPieces - Map of ship boards to their disconnected pieces
      shouldDiscard - Flag indicating whether removed components should be counted as losses
